about_the_game:
You arrive into a strange and dangerous world. No explanations. Your character is as confused as you. You can help each other. You don't know why you're here or what your goal is. Survive first and figure out the rest as you go.

Gameplay

  • Explore the world and look out for secrets and traps

  • Engage in slower paced methodical combat based around timing and positioning

  • Avoid confrontation when necessary. Gear up and come back later

  • Acquire new weapons, armor pieces and other useful items

  • Be tactical and smart about managing your resources 

  • Become powerful and face even greater challenges 

  • Discover and learn hidden systems and secrets 

Features

  • Cinematic style of presentation with changing camera angles and dramatic framing

  • No interruptions from dialogues or cutscenes

  • A mix of dark fantasy and cyberpunk setting in a nineties style aesthetics

  • brutal and colorful cartoon violence

  • elves with machineguns, vampires, robots and skeletons

  • some customisation options: selection of color scheme presets for the player

  • Movement and combat controls suitable for different input methods: mouse, keyboard and gaming controllers

content_descriptors.notes:
You can streak in the game. 

There's also violence, blood and naughty words.

name: Tamara

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: WIndows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300 or AMD FX-4350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTS 450 (1GB) or AMD Radeon HD 6570 (1GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 (2GB) or AMD Radeon HD 7870 (2GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Tamara is a Dungeon Crawler with elements of Survival Horror in a Cyberpunk-Fantasy Setting. Explore dungeons, bunkers, castles and abandoned cities in search of loot and methodically fight your way against all types of monsters and machines.
